title: Forecast motion. Account for every trajectory.
discipline: Temporal modeling / sports analytics / inference engineering
summary: A trajectory-forecasting project connecting player-motion representations, game-aware validation, complete-population evaluation, and measured inference acceleration.

signals.label: Recorded inference speedup with prediction parity

scope: The Python review executes a deterministic synthetic motion demo and its release validator. Optional browser checks test the actual route engine and controls. Recorded OOF and late-evaluation measurements remain separate from the synthetic demonstration.
private_boundary: Raw tracking data, private target rows, fitted ensembles, exact blend recipes, competition outputs, and full private serving state remain outside this review.

cards.title: Recover stages without accepting stale artifacts.
cards.decision: Bind reusable outputs to their input/source identity, and retain atomic file writes.
cards.boundary: These are public artifact-integrity contracts, not a production availability claim.

cards.title: Report the complete evaluation population.
cards.decision: Keep supported-population and full-population error distinct so unsupported rows do not disappear from the claim.
cards.boundary: OOF and late-evaluation populations are not interchangeable.

cards.title: Keep fitted reference predictions observation-only.
cards.decision: Check keyed forecasting, geometric invariance and global fallback with a small native fitted control.
cards.boundary: The reference control is not the private 20-model ensemble.

cards.title: Make the demonstration independently inspectable.
cards.decision: Generate synthetic trajectories, reports, and manifests from a dependency-free public implementation.
cards.boundary: A successful synthetic replay does not regenerate the withheld ensemble.
